changelog: Global Hotkeys (Win/macOS/Linux) with user-defined shortcuts and conflict status; antenna label renaming that persists across all views; improved Shortcut Picker (Record/Clear, multi-modifier combos like Ctrl+Shift+A, compact list); Hotkeys table with per-row Test results; native X11/macOS backends for out-of-focus hotkeys; updater reliability with backward-compatible manifest; assorted UI polish and stability fixes.
